Author: naco-ff14
Name: AltMate
Description: AltMate supports multiple FFXIV clients running on the same PC. It provides linked controls, housing tracking, Penumbra emote playback, and shared gil summaries. Data stays on the local PC. Japanese and English UI are supported.
Punchline: Multi-character linking, housing, animation, and gil tools
Changelog: v1.58.1: Send ready crafter quests through level 60 to Questionable for automatic acceptance and turn-in.
